data.title: Iconic Tower
data.about:
The collaboration between Mered and Pininfarina resulted in a conventionally stunning project called Iconic Tower. Set minutes away from Palm Jumeirah, Iconic Tower DIC comprises 310 apartment units.

The floor plan includes 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses offering spectacular views of the city's skyline. The tower will have five-level parking and a 15,000-square-foot retail space with other amenities like a restaurant, cafe, pool and kids' play area.

Focused on delivering world-class projects, Mered is dedicated to crafting spaces that blend sophisticated design with modern amenities, offering residents an unparalleled lifestyle experience in the heart of one of the world's most dynamic cities.

  • Top-class fitness facilities with a fully-equipped gym, yoga and relaxation room

location_tile.title: Located in the vibrant hub at the heart of technological advancements and global connectivity
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Mered Iconic Tower is positioned strategically in Dubai Internet City. The district provides residents with high-end facilities, including excellent road connectivity and public transportation. DIC's lively landscape accommodates diverse businesses, ranging from multinational corporations to pioneering startups, collectively contributing to Dubai's standing as a global technology and innovation hub. 

  • 05 min to Palm Jumeirah
  • 10 min to the Emirates Golf Club
  • 15 min to JBR
  • 20 min to Dubai Mall
